recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 LEF1 核染色：大片小型淋巴球浸潤中，散在強陽性的棕色細胞核（實心箭頭），多數細胞核僅弱染或陰性（空心箭頭），巨核細胞為陰性；LEF1 在 CLL 細胞中常呈核陽性，此視野強度不一，判讀需搭配 T 細胞內部對照。
features: Diffuse marrow infiltrate of small round lymphoid cells replacing hematopoiesis
Scattered cells with strong nuclear LEF1 staining (solid arrows)
Many lymphoid nuclei with weak or absent staining (open arrows)
Heterogeneous staining intensity rather than uniform strong nuclear positivity
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy stained for LEF1 shows a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with heterogeneous nuclear staining. Scattered nuclei are strongly positive (solid arrows), while many lymphoid nuclei show only weak or no staining (open arrows); megakaryocytes are negative. Strong positive cells may include background T cells, which normally express LEF1, so neoplastic-cell positivity should be judged against this internal control. Nuclear LEF1 expression in a CD5-positive small B-cell infiltrate supports chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma over other small B-cell lymphomas.

ddx.vs: MCL is typically LEF1-negative and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
MZL is LEF1-negative in B cells and usually CD5-negative.
Reactive aggregates show LEF1 only in T cells and contain mixed polytypic B and T cells.
